name: com.enioka.scanner.sdk.athesi.SPA43LTE.AthesiSPA43LTEProvider
description: When Enioka Scan searches an Athesi SPA43LTE device for its built-in reader, this service connects the SPA43LTE barcode scanner for app use.
disableEffect: The app can no longer scan barcodes with the built-in reader on an Athesi SPA43LTE device.
